headline: Tech rebounded sharply as oil slid, the dollar fell and VIX dropped 22%, despite Nvidia's 4% loss.
brief: The Nasdaq Composite rallied 2.74% to 25,253 and QQQ gained 3.5%, closing near the day's high as chipmakers outside Nvidia led and falling oil broadened gains. The dollar weakened sharply against the euro and yen while VIX fell to about 19.9, though the 10-yr edged up to 4.88%. Asia-session catalysts look light tonight; the key risk is positioning into Tuesday's US CPI and further headlines on Nvidia's board investigation.

sources.title: Motley Fool: Stock Market Today, Nov 9
